span.label: high-throughput DFT over crystal structures from the ICSD plus decorations of common prototypes, with formation energies compared against two experimental thermochemical databases and against each other
span.term: high-throughput DFT over crystal structures from the ICSD plus decorations of common prototypes, with formation energies compared against two experimental thermochemical databases and against each other
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the apparent DFT error is 0.096 eV/atom. The authors then measured how far different experimental determinations of the SAME formation energy sit from each other and got 0.082. Almost the whole gap is the width of the reference. THE CONTROL IS THAT THE STANDARD WAS ASKED HOW WELL IT AGREES WITH ITSELF, and almost nobody asks
span.term: measure the ruler before blaming the thing measured
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: on the 75 intermetallic compounds shared by the two thermochemical databases, the databases differ by 0.082 eV/atom and OQMD sits 0.071 from experiment. A model cannot be scored below the noise floor of its reference, and here it is already under it
span.term: the calculation closer to experiment than experiment is to itself
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the entire OQMD is downloadable without conditions or limitations, and it is computed from crystal structures obtained through a partnership with the ICSD. THE OPENNESS IS OF THE CALCULATION, NOT OF THE MEASUREMENT IT STARTED FROM - which is exactly the position the corpus itself is in
span.term: an open derivative of a closed source
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the elements whose predicted ground state is wrong are the ones held together by van der Waals forces, which the semi-local functionals omit by construction. The error is attributed to a missing term in the theory rather than to a fitting failure, and the paper says which elements and why
span.term: a known blind spot, named by physics rather than by residual
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: having compared what is known, the same stability analysis over ICSD compounds and hypothetical structures yields about 3,200 compounds predicted to exist that have never been characterised. The negative space of the experimental record, read off the same calculation
span.term: prediction as the leftover of a comparison
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the ground-state structure of a whole group of elements cannot be determined reliably with the semi-local functionals used, because van der Waals interactions are missing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: for noble gas and molecular solids the change in predicted stabilities cannot be substantiated, since van der Waals contributes a significant portion of the energy
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: where two experimental databases disagree there is no principled way to say which measurement is wrong, so the residual cannot be fully assigned

span.label: the structures are obtained from the ICSD by partnership; the openness of the derived data set does not extend to the source

span.label: inter-rater reliability logic from measurement theory - asking how far two independent determinations of the same quantity sit from each other before scoring a third against either

span.label: the deviation between different experimental measurements of the same formation energy, computed wherever multiple sources exist, before any error is attributed to the calculation

span.label: elements whose predicted ground state is wrong grouped by physical cause - missing van der Waals interactions, and f-electrons - rather than reported as residual
span.note: eliminates: a list of failures with no account of them; each group is attached to a known limitation of the functional · outcome: held
